content: The play after the convergence discovery (Tony's own words, April 1, 2026): (1) This week: stabilize at AutoZone, new apartment — the platform everything launches from. (2) Before next pay period: publish tight 2-3 page technical note to Zenodo — 'Independent Convergence: Context Entropy Solutions in Solo Research and Production AI Architecture.' Already written, PDF ready. (3) One cold outreach email to a specific Anthropic researcher/engineer. Not 'hire me' — 'I built the same thing independently, here's the published proof, I'd love to compare notes.' Peer-level introduction, not an application. The convergence is the best conversation starter Tony has ever had. Open thread recorded for identifying the right contact.
